products.name: Ollama
products.note: Local LLM runner; self-hosted; no data exfiltration; model supply-chain verification needed

profile_text.body:
Ollama is a software company that provides tooling for running open AI models, positioning itself around data privacy and ease of use. The company describes itself as "the easiest way to automate your work using open models, while keeping your data safe," and offers both local and cloud-hosted deployment options, with cloud infrastructure located in the US, Europe, and Singapore.

The company's primary product, also called Ollama, is a local large language model runner that is open source and self-hosted. It is tracked in this site's registry under the open source and self-hosted models category, with a note that it carries no data exfiltration risk in local mode but that model supply-chain verification is advised. The company also offers a cloud tier, which it describes as providing dedicated capacity for running multiple agents concurrently, with a stated policy that user data is never used for training by any provider.

No litigation, MCP server registrations, SEC filings, or patent records are held for Ollama at this time.
